items.name: History table — search, filters, pagination
items.description: The archive list at /history: search + type/status/date-range filters, a paginated table of closed and expired permits, and an empty state.
acceptance: src/router/modules/History.router.ts with prefix '/history', lazy-loaded, meta.auth set; registered in src/router/index.ts and reflected in the AGENTS.md Modules table
Reuses PermitProvider — no new provider dir
Toolbar: search (ID/title/location), type select, status select limited to Closed/Expired, from-date, to-date, Clear filters
Filters and search are sent to the API as query params, debounced via the existing Debounce util; not filtered client-side
Table columns: ID (mono) · TYPE badge · TITLE + LOCATION · CLOSED date + closed-by · DURATION · STATUS badge · chevron; each row has a 3px left border in the permit-type color
Pagination via the usePagination composable + src/components/table/Paginate.vue; result count shown above the table
Empty state with a Clear filters action
Table scrolls horizontally at 375px rather than truncating; no horizontal body scroll
./init.sh green
items.notes: Design lines 617-679. DONE. Route registered in src/router/index.ts. Filters+search drive the API query via buildQuery(); search debounced 400ms. Status filter is limited to CLOSED/EXPIRED by an ARCHIVE_STATUSES constant. || NOTE: the agent assigned this item died twice to infrastructure (machine sleep, then a 600s watchdog stall) with the module ~80% written. The orchestrator finished it: removed a dangling onSearchInput export left over from a superseded design, wrote HistoryListPage.vue, and fixed two lint errors (a typedef and a wrap-regex).
items.evidence: ./init.sh — typecheck PASS, lint PASS, tests PASS. Live Playwright probe after router registration: route renders with shell chrome, no pageerror, no horizontal overflow at 375/768/1280. /history renders 1431 chars.

items.name: History detail drawer
items.description: 520px right-hand slide-over showing an archived permit read-only, opened by clicking a row.
acceptance: Drawer opens on row click, closes on ✕ and on backdrop click; backdrop click inside the panel does not close it
Header: type badge, status badge, title, mono ID
A 'View Only · <status> — this record is archived and cannot be edited' bar is always visible
Read-only panels: location, foreman, date/time, duration, closed date, closed by; work description; a dashed placeholder row for the archived permit document
No edit, delete, or state-transition control exists anywhere in the drawer
Full-width on viewports narrower than 520px
./init.sh green

items.name: CSV export
items.description: Export the current filtered result set as CSV.
acceptance: Export respects the active search + filters, not just the current page
Columns match the table; dates formatted for Asia/Bangkok; permit IDs unquoted-safe
Thai text survives the round-trip — file is UTF-8 with a BOM so Excel does not mangle it
No new dependency — build the CSV with a small util and a Blob download
Unit test on the CSV serializer: a field containing a comma, a quote, and Thai characters
./init.sh green
items.notes: The UTF-8 BOM matters: without it Excel renders Thai as mojibake, which for a Thai facility is a real bug, not a nicety. DONE. src/utils/Csv.ts — csvEscapeField quotes only when a field has a comma/quote/newline, doubling embedded quotes per RFC 4180. UTF-8 BOM prepended so Excel does not render Thai as mojibake. Export refetches with limit 9999 so it covers the whole filtered set, not just the current page. 7 tests. || NOTE: the agent assigned this item died twice to infrastructure (machine sleep, then a 600s watchdog stall) with the module ~80% written. The orchestrator finished it: removed a dangling onSearchInput export left over from a superseded design, wrote HistoryListPage.vue, and fixed two lint errors (a typedef and a wrap-regex).
